name: Override: turn the left Toggle with the bars
description: Turns around and drives the bars on the lift tower into the left Toggle twice. On red's side the first hit turns the blue face into the field and the second the red one. Each hit is a drive that keeps moving into the next step, so the robot is still going fast when the bars reach the Toggle.

steps.note: 1 in left, clear of the preload
hit the Toggle: blue turns in
hit it again: red turns in
let go of the Toggle so it counts
